data.google_maps_api_key: Google Maps API key (optional; satellite maps by default)
data.name: Name (e.g. PV Garage)
data.forecast_solar_api_key: forecast.solar API key (optional, leave empty for public)
data.source_weight_dwd: DWD source weight (0-100, normalized with other active sources)
data.source_weight_open_meteo: Open-Meteo source weight (0-100, normalized with other active sources)
data.source_weight_forecast_solar: forecast.solar source weight (0-100, normalized with other active sources)

data_description.google_maps_api_key: Enable Maps JavaScript API (2D), Maps Static API (3D ground imagery) and billing. Restrict this browser key to both APIs and your Home Assistant website addresses. A saved key makes Google the default; Google receives map requests and charges may apply. Leave empty for OpenStreetMap.
data_description.name: Display name used as integration and entity prefix. Example: PV Garage
data_description.enable_dwd_source: Use DWD MOSMIX-L station data as a forecast source. Requires a valid station code.
data_description.enable_open_meteo_source: Use Open-Meteo global forecast as a forecast source. No API key required.
data_description.enable_forecast_solar_source: Use forecast.solar as a forecast source. Public API: 12 requests/hour, 1 call per PV array. Optional API key unlocks higher limits.
data_description.forecast_solar_api_key: Optional forecast.solar API key for personal/professional accounts. Leave empty for public (free) access.
data_description.source_weight_dwd: Weight for DWD source (0-100). All active source weights are normalized, so relative values matter, not absolute.
data_description.source_weight_open_meteo: Weight for Open-Meteo source (0-100). Normalized with other active sources.
data_description.source_weight_forecast_solar: Weight for forecast.solar source (0-100). Normalized with other active sources.
data_description.mosmix_station: DWD station code used for MOSMIX-L data. Example: N7244

user.description: Configure name, forecast sources and optional Google Maps here. Manage plant geometry, inverters and sensors in Solar forecast.

error.daily_sensors_exceed_forecast_days: Daily sensor days cannot exceed Open-Meteo forecast days
